text:
lucy_gts: Starting a quick thread for Asteria joint POC — they need: short private-tenant trial, security questionnaire status, pricing for a small dedicated pool, and enablement for SSO/SCIM.

omar_se: Asteria legal attached an SSQ and wants VPC peering + BYOK in prod. For pilot theyre okay with redwood-managed KMS. They also want a short audit artifact (redacted SOC2) and a controls checklist.

tia_privsec: I can take the SSQ. Ask them for network CIDRs, IdP metadata, and whether they require SIEM forwarding. For pilot we provide redacted SOC2 + controls matrix. Data deletion SLA: default 48h for ephemeral logs unless specified.

sam_ops: Ops can provision a constrained private-tenant trial for 10 business days if they sign a pilot addendum and prepay baseline capacity. We'll need teardown timers and a minimal ops runbook from their side.

ben_arch: Perf ask from Asteria: target 80 rps at 200 tokens, p50 <0.15s/token. With KV cache and moderate batching this fits a small reserved pool. Rough pricing: $22k-$36k/mo depending on region and exact GPU sku.

lucy_gts: Can we offer a 10-day no-commit trial so procurement can validate SSO and telemetry? They specifically said no sample data until SSO is in place.

omar_se: They use Azure AD; SCIM provisioning required. @ci-bot can we paste the minimal SAML/SCIM template?

ci-bot: SAML metadata sample:
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://redwood.example/saml\">
  <!-- ACS: https://console.redwood.example/saml/acs -->
  <!-- X509 cert, singleLogoutService -->
</EntityDescriptor>
```
SCIM basics: POST /scim/v2/Users Authorization: Bearer <token>. Supports PATCH for group sync.

tia_privsec: Also confirm whether they need HSM for production BYOK. For pilot, redwood-managed KMS with keys non-exportable is acceptable. If HSM needed later, we'll provide integration options and an attestation.

sam_ops: Ops action items: request Asteria CIDRs, provision trial tenant after prepay, publish egress IP list, and include teardown automation. We'll limit capacity for trial and document that it's single-az and not SLA-backed.

ben_arch: I'll prepare a perf-runbook: load phases, KV warm-up, expected autoscale curve, and a short cost-sensitivity table (cache hit vs reserved nodes). Will post tomorrow.

lucy_gts: Action list: 1) Tia = SSQ + SOC2 redacted + controls matrix, 2) Sam = trial tenant + prepay instructions + egress IPs, 3) Ben = perf sim + sizing, 4) Omar = collect IdP metadata & SCIM settings and schedule enablement.

omar_se: Asteria to send Azure AD metadata by EOD. I'll schedule a 45-min enablement to walk SAML/SCIM and telemetry endpoints once we have it.

tia_privsec: Also note: they asked for a sample data deletion attestation for procurement. I'll draft a one-page attestation and attach the SOC2 redacted.

lucy_gts: Great. If we get metadata and prepay, we can start the trial next week. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

ben_arch: One more note: recommend they start on hosted private-tenancy feature flags first to validate auth paths faster, flip to dedicated if perf requires. Lower friction for procurement.

lucy_gts: Closing thread; post updates here when quote, SSQ, or tenant details are ready.
